_source: Dev server :3001 (branch feat/mobile-api-foundations), 2026-10-19, bearer token. 400 with the IT user (mobile-dev@), 502/429 with the DE user (mobile-dev-de@: the server localizes the message to the account language). The local Resend key is a placeholder, so every valid report answers 502 (log: support.report.failed reason validation_error) and no email leaves the machine; `created` is therefore the contract example (api/endpoints/support.md), not a captured response.
